name: Ao no Exorcist: Genkoku no Labyrinth
original_name: 青の祓魔師 幻刻の迷宮
source:
Birthed between Satan and a human priestess, Rin and his brother Yukio are destined for great things and terrible dangers. Enter the school for the exorcists, deepen the bond between the brothers. Your final aim is to create a world where Demons can coexist with humans, so start off in school. Become friends with your classmates, and fight Demons that come across your path together.

[from [url=https://aonoexorcist.fandom.com/wiki/Blue_Exorcist:_The_Chronocyclic_Labyrinth]Blue Exorcist Wiki[/url]]
translation:
撒旦与人类女祭司之子奥村燐，与弟弟奥村雪男注定要面对伟大使命与可怕危险。进入驱魔师学校，深化兄弟羁绊。你最终的目标，是创造一个恶魔与人类能够共存的世界；一切就从校园生活开始。与同学成为朋友，并肩对抗一路遇到的恶魔。

[来自[url=https://aonoexorcist.fandom.com/wiki/Blue_Exorcist:_The_Chronocyclic_Labyrinth]《青之驱魔师》Wiki[/url]]
